techniques.name: Acquire Infrastructure
techniques.usage: Routes operator traffic through commercial VPN services such as ProtonVPN, so scanning and intrusion do not trace back.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.usage: Path traversal against the FortiOS SSL VPN portal retrieves system files without authenticating; the credentials inside are then used to connect as a real user. MITRE also names SQL injection as a second route, presented as an example rather than an exhaustive list.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell
techniques.usage: ASPXSpy web shells relay operator input to cmd.exe on the compromised server.

techniques.name: Server Software Component: Web Shell
techniques.usage: Plants multiple ASPXSpy variants as durable re-entry points.

techniques.name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service
techniques.usage: Registers the IPsec Helper backdoor as an auto-starting service.

techniques.name: Masquerading
techniques.usage: Renames the Plink tunnelling tool to systems.exe to blend with system binaries.

techniques.name: Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information
techniques.usage: Deploys base64-encoded ASPXSpy variants to slip past signature matching.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts: Domain Accounts
techniques.usage: Reuses valid domain credentials so subsequent activity reads as legitimate.

techniques.name: Disable or Modify Tools
techniques.usage: Loads the vulnerable GMER64.sys driver to terminate EDR and antivirus services from kernel mode.

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
techniques.usage: Mimikatz dumps plaintext and hashed credentials from memory.

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping: Security Account Manager
techniques.usage: Extracts the local SAM hive.

techniques.name: Brute Force: Password Spraying
techniques.usage: Sprays recovered credentials over SMB to widen access.

techniques.name: Network Service Discovery
techniques.usage: Scans hosts and services with the WinEggDrop port scanner.

techniques.name: Remote System Discovery
techniques.usage: Enumerates reachable hosts with NBTscan.

techniques.name: Remote Services: Remote Desktop Protocol
techniques.usage: Tunnels RDP through web shells and Plink to pivot deeper into the estate.

techniques.name: Lateral Tool Transfer
techniques.usage: Pulls payloads from file-sharing sites rather than hosting infrastructure itself.

techniques.name: Automated Collection
techniques.usage: Custom sql.net4.exe queries SQL databases and extracts personally identifiable information.

techniques.name: Data from Local System
techniques.usage: Gathers files from database and other critical servers.

techniques.name: Archive Collected Data: Archive via Utility
techniques.usage: Compresses the haul with 7zip before transfer.

techniques.name: Data Staged: Local Data Staging
techniques.usage: Parks archives in C:\windows\temp\s\ ahead of exfiltration.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.usage: Moves staged archives out using PuTTY and WinSCP.

techniques.name: Data Destruction
techniques.usage: Detonates wipers that present a ransom note while the data is already unrecoverable. Destruction is the objective; the ransomware is cover.

arsenal.name: ASPXSpy
arsenal.role: ASP.NET web shell used for execution and persistence

arsenal.name: IPsec Helper
arsenal.role: Post-exploitation remote-access framework run as a service

arsenal.name: BFG Agonizer
arsenal.role: Wiper used in later destructive operations
